files.drill.title: Fire drill
files.drill.help: Rehearse the hub going down during class. Phones keep working from their stored copy and catch up afterwards.
files.drill.s0: Start the drill, then stop the hub when asked. Learners need no action.
files.drill.s1: The drill is running and the hub is treated as stopped. Switch the hub off now if it is not already. Then continue to check that the phones keep working.
files.drill.hubDown: The hub is off: as expected.
files.drill.hubStillUp: The hub still answers. The checks below ran anyway.
files.drill.copyOk: This device holds the class content it needs.
files.drill.copyMissing: This device holds no stored copy of the class. Open the app once while connected.
files.drill.opened: Released sections opened from the stored copy: {n} of {m}.
files.drill.s2: Now start the hub again. Phones send what they kept and catch up.
files.drill.caughtUp: The hub answered and this device caught up.
files.drill.catchPending: The hub is not back yet. Catch-up will happen automatically when it is.
files.drill.phones: Phones that confirmed they kept working: {n} of {m}.
files.learner.importedDetail: The package is signed by your hub and now also shows under Day 0.
files.trainer.acceptedDetail: The submission from {who} was checked and stored.
files.day.saved: Saved on this phone. It works without the hub.
